meta.title: The TanStack Table alternative with a ready-made grid UI | AG Grid
meta.description: Looking for a TanStack Table alternative? AG Grid is a JavaScript data grid for React, Angular, Vue and JavaScript with a free MIT-licensed core. Compare features, pricing and licensing.

hero.heading: A TanStack Table alternative
hero.subHeading: Looking for a TanStack Table alternative? AG Grid is a complete JavaScript data grid with its own UI, virtualisation, editing and export, free under the MIT licence in AG Grid Community.

whySwitch.heading: Why teams look for a TanStack Table alternative
reasons: TanStack Table is headless, so the developer writes all the table markup and CSS.
Virtualisation needs the separate TanStack Virtual package, and cell editing is not in its core.
Its built-in features do not include pivoting, CSV or Excel export, or charts.

whyProduct.title: One grid for every framework
whyProduct.body: Official packages for React, Angular and Vue, plus plain JavaScript, with the same grid features in each.

whyProduct.title: Large datasets in the free version
whyProduct.body: Row and column virtualisation are on by default in AG Grid Community, and the Infinite Row Model loads data from the server as users scroll.

whyProduct.title: Analysis built into the grid
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Enterprise adds row grouping, aggregation, pivoting, master/detail, Excel export and integrated charts to the same component.

whyProduct.title: Clear licensing
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Community is MIT licensed. AG Grid Enterprise is a perpetual licence with one year of updates and support.

faq.question: What is the difference between AG Grid and TanStack Table?
faq.answer: AG Grid renders a complete grid UI with built-in virtualisation, editing and export. TanStack Table is headless: it provides the table logic and you write the markup and CSS.

faq.question: Is AG Grid free like TanStack Table?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence, as TanStack Table is. AG Grid Enterprise is a paid licence for features such as pivoting, Excel export and integrated charts.

faq.question: How much does an AG Grid licence cost?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is free. AG Grid Enterprise, and the Enterprise Bundle with AG Charts Enterprise, are paid perpetual licences that include one year of updates and support. See [AG Grid pricing](/license-pricing/) for prices.

proseClaims.claim: TanStack Table is headless: it provides table state and logic, and you write the markup and CSS.
TanStack Table has no built-in virtualisation and pairs with the separate TanStack Virtual package.
TanStack Table has no cell editing in its core, and its built-in features do not include pivoting, CSV or Excel export, or charts.
